verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe running periodic user access reviews directly in Secureframe. User data is pulled from native or custom integrations or CSV, reviewers are designated per system on recurring schedules with reminders, and they decide in-app to maintain, modify, revoke, or mark access out of scope, with follow-up tasks syncing to ticketing tools. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the completed review artifact is stored in an evidence library or auditor-facing evidence store, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the workflow.
